thread:
Maya: Morning async — quick check-in for launch week. What I did: finalized the content calendar rows for Day 1–3 and uploaded hero assets to the drive. Blockers: still missing the final inference cost numbers from eng for the benchmark post, and need a simple event name to pass to analytics so we can A/B by variant. Today: polish the benchmark post copy + request code review for the landing microcopy.

Raj: on the numbers — Alex is pulling the per-token cost for the hosted run, should have a CSV by EOD. pinged him now. :eyes:

Alex: sending CSV to the channel when ready. Quick note: the bench script we used is in repo `infra/benchmarks/launch-2025` and the command was:
```
python run_bench.py --model redwood-alpha --steps 500 --batch 8 --save results/day1.csv
```
Raw numbers will include p95 latency + tokens/sec.

Chris: for analytics event name, can we standardize on `launch_bench_click`? keeps it short and consistent with other events.

Maya: `launch_bench_click` works for me. I also need a snippet for the CTA so the growth widget can hook in.

Sam: I reviewed the microcopy PR (PR #542) and left two small nits. @Maya can you take a look at the suggested alt phrasing for the headline?

Maya: yep will apply. Can someone from eng approve the instrumentation change? it's 3 lines in the frontend:
```js
trackEvent('launch_bench_click', { variant: 'compact' });
```

Olivia: I can approve once Alex confirms the event schema (string keys + optional metadata).

Alex: schema is `{ event: string, user_id?: string, props?: object }` — any props we send should be small. We'll log `variant` and `model_name`.

Raj: tagging @deploy-bot — do we have a safe window to deploy the change to staging? want to run full end-to-end before Day 1.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment window available tonight 22:00 UTC — will do a canary to 5% then promote if no errors within 15m.

Maya: perfect. Two asks: (1) please attach the CSV Alex uploads to the benchmark doc and call out p95; (2) can QA smoke the CTA tracking in staging after the canary?

Alex: will attach CSV and include a short table of p50/p95/throughput.

Sam: QA will validate instrumented event — leaving a test checklist item: click CTA, confirm event in analytics pipeline with `variant` and `model_name`. I'll add that to the QA doc.

Chris: small heads-up — landing needs the hero alt copy localized to EN/FR. @Maya can you drop translations in the doc?

Maya: adding EN/FR now. One more blocker: the benchmark images are slightly large, @eng can we get a tiny optimization pass (webp, 60% quality) to speed load?

Alex: will send a script to batch-convert, e.g.:
```bash
find assets/hero -type f -name '*.png' -exec convert {} -quality 60 -format webp {}.webp \;
```
Tested on staging assets, looks fine.

Olivia: sounds good. If we can get the CSV + deployment by EOD, marketing can lock the publish schedule. :thumbsup: 

Maya: thanks team — leave any final PR approvals in the PR thread and I'll merge once the event is in staging. :shipit:

Alex: CSV posted to the doc here: https://redwood.in/launch/bench-results-day1.csv — ping if you need raw logs.

Sam: QA will smoke test after deploy, I'll update this thread with results.

Maya: closing the loop — if no major issues, we go live with the benchmark post tomorrow 15:00 PT.
